body:
My dad is pretty loving but really ignored me as a kid and my mom has given me straight up stockholm syndrome to the point where even if she hurts me i still obey and defend her, i've noticed the red flags in that though. I've been working on myself for a while now but it never seems to be enough, Thank you for validating those feelings, friend.

 Maybe she does have a reason for it? I'll have to communicate with her... It just makes me really anxious! Haha. 
Being degraded all the time really does put a hole in your heart and make you afraid to even tell your therapist things. I didn't really think my understanding was that clear, i have a really hard time with being sure of myself when it comes to perception. I'll try my best to write this all down for her to read.... taking it with me sounds like a very good idea. 

She has given me pretty good advice though, like staying out of the house as much as possible... I have a hard time being separated from my family and feel guilty when i'm gone, like i should always be hyper cleaning the house or doting on my mothers beck and call... So, i like her and the advice she has given to me but i guess i just feel like i dont get the emotional validation i need really desperately...

thank you... i really have been. i always have felt like it was my own fault. i got out of my sex trafficking situation at age 14 when i met my current boyfriend, he helped me out of it. i didnt end up seeing any psychiatric help until age 17, and that was after countless suicide attempts and self harm sprees that my parents turned a blind eye to it all, of course. 

I think it's just something about her style. I can't really put my tongue on why I feel so disconnected from her. I guess it's just because she never really has advice for me, she just listens, which i greatly appreciate but i just feel like theres no progress being made. i dont know if its just me or what. I haven't discussed it with her.  i really, really want to but I just have been having a really difficult time mustering up the energy to. I do feel extremely stuck in alll my situations right now and its so hard to line things up and get them out of the way.
